notes.title: Eastern Exorcist Major Update! Full version now playable!
notes.notes:
Dear fellow exorcists，

Thank you all for the wait! Eastern Exorcist has now been updated to the full version. 

As the first game of Wildfire Studio, Eastern Exorcist has been produced and polished for almost 4 years. Thanks to our players who have supported us along the way, who gave us a lot of valuable suggestions during the early access version of the game, so that we can take the game further.

The development process is difficult. Fortunately, many players support us, which makes us feel a little light in the middle of the night. We have limited abilities, but we want to do our best to finish the game Eastern Exorcist and do it well.
Of course, everyone in the team will not relax in the future and will continue to understand everyone's opinions and insist on polishing the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/2e8f8bdef11f0c9a07ff837a4ddafb3702eea4ed.png[/img]

Thank you for staying with us! And enjoy the game!



* Turkish localization will be added very soon
* Part of the English localization is still under polishing, thank you for understanding

notes.title: Early Access Update 8.27
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/2b409f49683bffeb1da6a70a682a0e0b1782534a.jpg[/img]
[b]Version number: 1.13.0827
[/b]
Hello Exorcists,

The main aim of this update is to improve the game experience and fix bugs. The controls will respond better now, and you can stop the use of Charged Attack at any time. Please refer to the changelog below for more details.

Thank you all in the community for your feedback and support. We will continue to monitor responses in the community and work to optimize your gameplay experience. We plan to focus on optimizing skills and boss battles in future updates, so please stay tuned! 

[h3]Functionality Improvements:
[/h3][olist]
[*] [Controls] We’ve changed the controller settings to try to solve the occasional controller signal error.
[*] [Key Settings] We’ve added a shortcut key for the map.
[*] [Screen Settings] We’ve added a vertical sync selection.
[*] [Reset] This function now requires a long press to confirm the action and complete it. This will help to avoid triggering it by accident.
[*] [HUD] Adjustments were made to the lower right corner of the display showing the increase and decrease in Power points to make the changes more visible.
[*] [Charged Attack] Effect has been optimised.
[*] [Exclamation Point Warning] Prompts show more dynamically now, based on actual attack strength and TGH difference.
[/olist]

[h3]Bug Fixes:
[/h3][olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player’s strike resulted in an insta-kill of all enemies under certain circumstances. 
[*] Fixed the button prompt error that shows up when opening the mini-map with PS4 controllers which are wired. 
[*] We’ve made changes to try to fix the problem of Colonel Yin dropping into the ground in the boss battle.
[*] Fixed the issue where visibility of hints in Challenges were blocked due to the change to New Game+.
[*] Corrected some misspellings. 
[*] Fixed a bug where going into a tutorial stage and exiting quickly, then clearing a Challenge stage would return your character back to Wuli Lake.
[/olist]


[h3]Game Experience Adjustments:
[/h3][olist]
[*] [Charged Attack] We’ve improved the activation triggers to solve the problem of accidentally starting the Charged Attack process while pressing other controls. 
[*] [Charged Attack] The Charged Attack can be cancelled at any time by using Break, Dodge or Dash.
[*] [When attacked] You can now cancel out the post-attack action by tilting slightly upwards using Dodge and Dash. 
[*] [New Game+ Experience] The Power of enemies will increase significantly with each replay.
[*] [New Game+ Experience] The enemy stats will be adjusted upon replay. Stats will increase significantly.
[*] [Dark Shadow Spell] Mana acquisition efficiency has been adjusted.
[*] [Dark Shadow Spell] Adjusted part of the triggering of shadow attacks, and improved the problem where shadows were being limited by terrain when attacking.
[/olist]

----------
As the game is still in EA now, our team will continue to communicate with all our supporters and combine feedback to make the game better. We value and welcome your feedback.

See you next time, Exorcists.

notes.title: Eastern Exorcist Early Access Update
notes.notes:
Hello Exorcists,

Hello Exorcists, it’s been almost a week since the release of Eastern Exorcist in EA. We would like to thank every Exorcist for your support!

This is a post to tell you more about what we have planned in Phase Two. Since the last round of updates, the production team has been working on the problems which have been highlighted to us, in addition to fixing bugs. We’ve gone through a round of optimisation and polishing to bring this patch to you. Please update the game for an improved experience! 

Once again, thank you for your support of Eastern Exorcist! 

[h2]Update 2 Changelog：
Version：1.13.0819

[h3][Improved Functionality][/h3]
[list]
[*] Tutorial tips do not pop up in NEW GAME+ and Trial modes.
[*] The NEW GAME+ tutorial level is skipped.
[*] More functions added to skills and ways to use skills. The skills which have already been activated in the [Skill Tree] can be clicked on and removed after confirmation. You will get 60% of your Power and all your Essence back.
[/list]

[h3][Bug Fixes][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where there were inaccuracies in the monster movement mapping.
[*] Fixed a bug where some flying enemies remained hovering after being weakened (or after the boss monster shield was broken).
[*] Fixed a bug where there were occasional freezes in dialogue in certain situations.
[*] Fixed the inaccurate duration of the [Nirvana] effect of the [Vajra Spell].
[/list]

[h3][Gameplay Experience Adjustments][/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve tweaked the feel of [Jump], and the protagonist can now stay in the air for longer, and has better aerial maneuverability.
[*] The interval between [Aerial Attack] attacks have been shortened significantly, and has better hovering capabilities. Stamina consumption has been reduced by 33%, so you can now perform continuous attacks in the air.
[*] Parameters for the execution of [Perfect Dodge] can be met more easily now.
[*] The [Dodge] and [Dash] usage intervals have been shortened, and maneuverability of continuous [Dodge] and [Dash] actions have been greatly improved.
[*]  [Perfect Dodge Counter Attack] will now eliminate the projectiles and ground effects (fire on the ground, poison, etc.) from enemies in the middle of your advance.
[*] You can now control the direction of your [Dodge Counter] by holding down the arrow keys. 
[*] The movement mechanism of [Charged Attack] has been reworked. It is now a two-stage stamina system. There will no longer be an automatic cancellation when the Stamina has been overcharged. Players will never miss the chance to activate it.
[*] You can still attack before the first stage is complete. It will be as powerful as a normal attack.
[*] When you’ve charged it fully in the first stage, the power of the attack is the same as the Charged Attack effect.
[*] When you’ve charged it fully in the second stage, shield-breaking and damage are significantly increased.
[*] A 20% reduction in shield breaking performance for [Jumping Slash] [Downward Slash].
[*] [Skill Adjustments]: [Water Dragon Chant] increases the mana recovery for [Riverside House], [Cool Breeze] and [Imbibe], speeding up mana circulation.
[*] [Skill Adjustments]: The [Water Dragon Chant] [Long Sword Summon] can now eliminate projectiles and ground effects (fire on the ground, poison, etc.) from enemies within striking range.
[*] [Skill Adjustments]: The firing position of the [Sword Spell] [Flying Flame Swords] has been adjusted to avoid overlapping with the character, and [Flying Flame Swords] will now automatically lock on to the target.
[*] [Skill Adjustments]: [Sword Spell] [Qi Practice Spell III] has an increased mana recovery mechanism, shortening the cooldown for [Cold Ice] and [Red Flame].
[*] Adjusted the behavioural pattern of Wraiths in Chapter 2, so they will not wander about for a long time.
[*] Adjusted the Dragon boss combat experience. 
[*] Added the Dragon boss transition animation.
[*] Adjusted the number of Wraiths summoned by the Treant boss. Increased tips for the Treant’s person-attraction spell.
[*] Fixed the problem with the boss attack decision frames. 
[*] Shields on some Challenge bosses have been raised overall to solve the problem of them being too vulnerable.
[/list]

–––––––

Known bugs (which will be fixed in an update coming soon): Text display in the map interface of the PS4 controller.

As we’ve hoped in publishing the game in EA, the development team will be paying attention to every comment and message, and keep in touch with all of you in the official group and community. We will collect all of your feedback to make the game better. We welcome everyone to join the group and give us your valued feedback and comments.

See you all next time, Exorcists!

notes.title: GAME UPDATE June 25
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/cf05e1916634682146a497e2da0d96cf6e1a8fbe.jpg[/img]
Dear exorcists,

We’ve updated a build with the brand new feel of protagonist Luyunchuan and gaming experience optimizations.

Please feel free to leave your comment and we are happy to hear from you :3

[b]Enhancement:[/b]
[list]
[*] Add support for left Ctrl, Alt, and keypad keys in key bindings
[*] Add a switch to display the player's HP bar HUD
[*] Video volume can now be set separately
[*] Improved speed of [Running]
[*] Improved speed of [Jump] 
[*] The movement curve of [Jump] is readjusted for more flexible maneuverability.
[*] [Dodge Counterattack] Speed up and automatically adapts the distance to the nearest enemy
[*] Shorten the framing time of "Evade" 
[*] The effective decision interval for [Break] has been shortened
[*] The lift animation of [Defense] is greatly accelerated 
[*] [Jump Attack]automatically adapts the attack distance to the nearest enemy
[*] The activation speed of [Jump Attack] is significantly faster and the backswing time is shorter
[*] The timing of the [Jump Attack] followed by the [Slash] is slightly earlier and the timing of the connection is tighter.
[*] The damage and armor penetration performance of [Jump Attack] is slightly lowered
[*] Slightly extend the attack range of [Slash] 
[*] [Slash] damage back to Beta 1.01 strength 
[*] [Normal Attack] Slight increase in damage for 4-hit combos 
[*] The enemy's attack damage is further reduced in [Easy Mode] 
[/list]

[b]BUG Fix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an infinite load issue caused by the asynchronous load policy at first launch
[*] Enabled gamepad vibration
[*] Fixed the playback delay caused by non-preloaded videos
[*] Re-export the in-game video to resolve the stuttering video playback experience
[*] Fixed an issue that the protagonist would not be able to dive immediately while in the air
[*] Fixed an issue that [Air Slash] didn't perform immediately during the jump phase
[*] Fixed an issue that the knockback distance of [Slash] was incorrectly calculated
[*] Fixed the problem that when [Dodge Attack] connects with [Jump Attack] but hits [Counter Attack] instead
[*] Fixed some skill logic for boss skills
[/list]

notes.title: GAME UPDATE June 19
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/cf05e1916634682146a497e2da0d96cf6e1a8fbe.jpg[/img]
Dear exorcists,

We’ve updated a build with the brand new feel of protagonist Luyunchuan and gaming experience optimizations.

Please feel free to leave your comment and we are happy to hear from you :3

[b]New Contents:[/b]
The new version of protagonist Luyunchuan with smoother actions
Added "Easy Mode", which significantly reduces stamina consumption

[b]BUG Fix:[/b]
Fixed the problem of accidental triggering Jump Attack 
Fixed the bug that perfect dodge could not gain the invincible status in some situations

[b]Gaming Experience[/b]
Slightly lowered the damage and armor penetration performance of Heavy Attack
Slightly lowered  armor penetration performance for perfect dodge counterattacks
The death screen now stays open for 10 seconds and can be closed manually

notes.title: GAME UPDATE June 18
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/4823774b9b79d0349bca2564cba8bc393f29f0c5.jpg[/img]

Dear exorcists,

We’ve updated a build in which fixed the controller lt/rt issues and contained lots of gaming experience optimizations.

Please feel free to leave your comment and we are happy to hear from you :3

[b]BUG fix:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed the problem that the "shift" key does not work in Key Binding
[*] Fixed the controller configuration issues with the invalid LT\RT function
[*] Fixed some conflicts and latency caused by key binding
[*] Fixed an issue that  ‘’Thunder Control’ skill does not work properly
[*] Fixed the wrong upgrade interface in Shrine 
[/olist]

[b]Gaming experience[/b]
[olist]
[*] Slightly reduced stamina consumption for normal attacks
[*] Reduced the waiting time for exhausted stamina regaining 
[*] You can jump now when you run out of stamina
[*] The decision interval of the Break is slightly shifted forward and the length remains the same、
[*] The armor penetration performance of Heavy Attack is slightly down
[*] The armor penetration performance of normal attack, Slash, jump attack, and Break is slightly up
[*] The damage and strength of jump attack are increased
[*] Slight decrease in dash stamina consumption
[*] Stamina bonus increase for perfect dodge
[/olist]
